import build123d as bd
from build123d import Box, Cylinder, Plane, ShapeList, Vertex, Vector

# All dimensions in mm here; geometry will be exported after scaling to metres.
R = 30.0                 # vessel internal radius (120 mm ID)
H = 200.0                # internal height
OUTLET_R = 10.0          # 40 mm outlet radius
PORT_W = 20.0
PORT_H = 30.0
PORT_Z = 55.0            # center: lower edge is 40 mm above floor
DUCT_L = 54.0            # 50 mm external + 4 mm penetration through wall
PENETRATION = 2.0
TILT = 15.0              # measured inward from local tangent

vessel = Cylinder(R, H).locate(bd.Pos(0, 0, H/2)).moved(bd.Location((0,0,0)))
parts = [vessel]
duct_axes = []
for i in range(4):
    a = math.radians(90*i)
    ta, ca = math.tan((1,1)), None
    c, s = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
    radial = np.array([c, s, 0.0])
    tangent = np.array([-s, c, 0.0])
    tilt = math.radians(TILT)
    inward = math.cos(tilt)*tangent - math.sin(tilt)*radial
    outward = -inward
    angle = math.degrees(math.atan2(outward[1], outward[0]))
    inner = (R-PENETRATION)*radial
    center = inner + outward*(DUCT_L/2)
    d = Box(DUCT_L, PORT_W, PORT_H, rotation=(0,0,angle))
    d = d.moved(bd.Pos(center[0], center[1], PORT_Z))
